review_type: Author review of cumulative assessment/project/reference package; not independent validation

components.diagnostic: Eight prerequisite questions and complete answers; 32-point scoring, algebra/domains/calculus/limits and specific remediation routes.
components.examinations: Two distinct 100-point forms, each with five 20-point essential domains and complete matching solutions/subpart scoring. Form A covers labeled finite selection, waiting/joint laws, integrable strong law and conditional uniqueness/tower, finite-population/normal/Holm inference, beta predictive decisions, log utility and report value. Form B changes the structure to Poisson convolution, latent mixtures/shared shocks, L1/L2 contrast, predictable bounded stopping, unequal inclusion/endpoint/power inference, gamma/normal/model-odds Bayes, CARA calibration and garbling. All twelve chapter routes assessed across the combined instruments; timings and thresholds are author proposals.
components.project: Original documented JSON experiment with distinct prevalence and state-stratified reliability samples, independent proper beta priors, finite state/report/payoff/fee laws, CARA aversion and alternative priors, fixed-reference seeded simulation controls. Stdlib benchmark computes normalized posteriors/predictive count, exact-fraction state/policy values, interval/p-value/coverage diagnostics, fee/utility/prior sensitivity, paired out-of-sample proper losses and group calibration.
components.oral_retention: Five-task changed-case oral protocol with scoring, five-domain fully solved delayed retention assessment and chapter remediation map.
components.reference: Notation table, all twelve chapter concept/reconstruction routes and synthesis toward reproducible empirical work, econometrics, microeconomics and finance.

validation.arithmetic: Independent labeled permutations and population subsets, waiting/tail quadrature, exact joint/latent moments and forecast errors, Poisson factorial convolution, covariance-based mean variance, predictable/stopped histories, rational inverse-inclusion moments, normal probabilities and Holm steps, beta-polynomial predictive moments, gamma predictive quadrature, normal precision/model odds, CARA moments, report-policy enumeration and every determinate retention calculation.
validation.project: Independent rational beta-polynomial normalizers versus benchmark factorial integrals; density/CDF quantile quadrature; exact beta-binomial PMF/moment/tail check; independently inverted binomial endpoints, exact null tails and rational-law coverage grid; all finite report policies, posterior action thresholds, fee comparisons, direct CARA expected-utility scaling, alternative-prior exact values. Fixed-reference expected scores independently averaged over four states, paired-difference variance computed from its full law, seeded discrepancies assessed against sampling error and group counts. Integrated checker passes.
validation.reasoning: Audited confidence versus credibility and size versus power; support/boundary bootstrap failure; iid moment conditions and shared-dependence counterexamples; conditional uniqueness/tower and bounded stopped-increment proof; predictive versus conditionally independent outcomes; proper forecast and sharpness/accuracy distinction. Project correctly separates chosen-stratum validation from prevalence estimation, independent posterior moment products from dependent alternatives, fixed-truth iid simulation from shared-parameter predictive cohorts, and economic fees from utility units. CARA deterministic-fee CE translation is justified exactly.
validation.structure: Eight diagnostic solutions, five questions and matching domain solutions in each exam, five retention solutions, complete project/rubric/instructor/benchmark links, twelve chapter routes, notation/concept/synthesis anchors and print aggregation. Integrated source-ID/local-target/anchor checks passed for 44 HTML pages.

corrections: Combined Question 3's final solution subpart into its own list item so Form B has five matching domain solutions with clear numbering.
Corrected a draft wording typo to describe the interval coverage guarantee accurately.
Fixed the numerical checker's direct float-versus-rational equality and used numerical closeness for square-root comparisons; manuscript answers were independently verified.

Added input guards against incompatible payoff ordering, observed sample-count mismatch and negative aversion in the benchmark; conditional report forecasts are available even if a user changes the displayed aversion scenarios.
Changed Chapter 12's assessment route from its planned specification to the actual complete package.
limitations: No independent human reviewer or learner validation of timing, difficulty or advancement thresholds.
Finite coverage grids and simulations are diagnostics; they do not prove uniform coverage, forecasting truth or learner competence.
The benchmark applies to the documented finite-payoff, independent-beta training model and integer shapes; a correlated/hierarchical prior or selected/duplicated data requires a changed analysis.
The synthetic fixed reference world is explicitly distinct from the posterior; parameter beliefs do not certify that world or a real investment.

Measure-extension/product construction, general regular conditional distributions, unbounded stopping extensions and continuous-time stochastic methods retain the explicit further-study boundaries recorded in Chapter 12.
Visual/mobile/print UI QA remains pending after the earlier browser-policy rejection.
acceptance: Accepted by author after complete analytic/solution/project review and successful independent numerical and integrated structural checks. All twelve Volume 3 chapters and its full assessment/project/reference package meet the author's production contract. This is library-package acceptance, not external academic certification, demonstrated learner mastery or completion of the whole 18-volume library.
